honors.title: Navy and Marine Corps Achievement Medal
honors.description: While on surge deployment 2009 in support of Operation Enduring Freedom, he led the troubleshooting and repair of 20 critical casualties within the Aegis Display Suite, highlighted by the rapid repair of the OL-191 Digital Video Processor which restored tactical video display of the ship's radar suites to all consoles in the Combat Information Center. His superlative efforts resulted in 100% Aegis Display Equipment Operability throughout the 147 day deployment and allowed Chancellorsville to excel as Ronald Reagan Strike Group Air Defense Commander and Force Track Coordinator.
